title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (AI Platform)
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 Affirm's engineering team is building a large-scale, fault-tolerant, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products, merchants, and vendors. Ensuring that our infrastructure is transparently available to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of writing blameless postmortems as well as writing detailed tech specs and gathering feedback before large changes to systems.
The AI Platform team owns Affirm's paved path for building, running, evaluating, and governing AI systems. Our customers are not only Affirm users, but also every engineer and a growing set of production workloads at Affirm. As a team, we are responsible for building and exposing simple, governed interfaces to models, tools, and agents, with identity, cost attribution, reliability, and security built in. Examples of components we own include the LLM Gateway that fronts every approved model (Claude, ChatGPT, and open-weight models across AWS Bedrock and other providers), the MCP Gateway that mediates and audits tool calls, the Agent Runtime that gives agentic workloads bounded execution, and the evals and observability layer that tells teams whether an AI change is better, cheaper, or safe to ship. We are early: the gateway is in daily use across engineering, the first production agent is live, and the next year takes us from developer productivity to production inference and agents.
 What You'll Do
 Plan, execute, and own technical decisions and projects within the AI Platform team, from design through launch and on-call.
 Design and build the gateway, runtime, and evaluation services that take AI workloads at Affirm from pilot to production, securely scaling across millions of users and their transactions.

title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager -  Core Ads Ranking
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .
 The Team
The Core Ads Ranking team advances user representation and graph learning, improves sequence modeling across ads verticals, and builds robust pipelines and state‑of‑the‑art architectures for foundational models. The team also leads core initiatives in knowledge distillation, model calibration, and heuristic improvement.
 This role offers a unique opportunity to shape and scale Reddit’s foundational modeling and deep user‑understanding roadmap, while multiplying impact through close collaboration with downstream teams including Retrieval, Shopping, Click Prediction, Video View‑Through Prediction, Conversion Prediction, and App Ads Modeling. This position is ideal for a leader with deep machine learning expertise, strong strategic vision, and a collaborative mindset capable of engaging effectively with both technical and cross‑functional partners.
 Responsibilities:
 Set Technical Vision and Strategy: Define and execute a roadmap for foundational model and user understanding, balancing high-ambuiguity long-term investments with measurable milestones.
 Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with vertical customer teams, horizontal signal teams, and infrastructure/platform teams to align on direction, strategy, priorities, and constraints.
 Drive Technical Execution: Oversee the model development lifecycle from ideation to deployment, ensuring high standards of ML performance, reliability, and robustness.

title: Regional Security Manager, APAC
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .
 As the Regional Security Manager, APAC, you'll lead the development and execution of Coinbase's regional security strategy on the Global Security team, protecting our people, workplaces, and operations across a diverse and rapidly evolving region. You'll own the physical security program for APAC offices, critical facilities, and data centers, partnering with business leaders and cross-functional teams to manage risk, strengthen resilience, and drive incident response across multiple countries.
 What you'll do:
 Own the APAC physical security operating plan, regional risk register, site security standards, and remediation priorities across offices, critical facilities, and data centers.
 Lead site assessments, vulnerability reviews, security hardening projects, new office openings, relocations, and security system deployments across the region.
 Serve as the regional escalation point and Incident Commander for significant security events, coordinating the GSOC, workplace teams, vendors, building management, and emergency services.
 Govern regional access control, badging, visitor management, secure area access, and audit readiness while managing contracted security providers through SLAs, KPIs, and QBRs.
 Develop and maintain regional policies, SOPs, playbooks, drills, tabletop exercises, and employee-facing security guidance informed by APAC threat intelligence and local cond…

title: Nageldesigner*in & Fußpfleger*in (evtl. auch Wimpernstylist*in)
description:
Über Jessica Marciniak Skin & more Im Studio Jessica Marciniak Skin & more in Düsseldorf-Unterbilk suchen wir Verstärkung auf Minijob-Basis. Wir bauen gerade unser zweites Studio auf und brauchen Verstärkung beim Aufbau. Anfangs brauchen wir Hilfe bei 1-2 Tagen die Woche. Langfristig suchen wir jemanden für 5 Tage die Woche.
 Ihre Aufgaben Sie sind für die professionelle Nagelpflege und Fußpflege zuständig. Bei entsprechender Eignung und Interesse kommt optional auch die Arbeit als Wimpern- & Augenbrauenstylistin hinzu.
 Das bringen Sie mit Sie bringen Erfahrung im Bereich Nageldesign und Fußpflege mit und arbeiten kundenorientiert im Studio in Düsseldorf. Voraussetzung ist, dass Sie deutsch sprechen und Ihre Arbeit professionell ausführen können. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.
 Vergütung Für diese Tätigkeit auf Minijob-Basis erhalten Sie eine Vergütung von EUR 13–14 per hour. Bei guter Arbeit ist eine Steigerung natürlich gegeben.
 Ihre ersten Monate bei Jessica Marciniak Skin & more In den ersten Wochen übernehmen Sie eigenständig Behandlungen in Nageldesign und Fußpflege und betreuen unsere Kunden vor Ort in Düsseldorf. Sie lernen unsere Studioabläufe kennen und setzen Ihr Fachwissen direkt im Praxisalltag ein.
